worker_handshake.phase: sidecar CONNECT before any request frame
worker_handshake.protocol: existing strict handshake negotiates the worker protocol version and engine identity
worker_handshake.mismatch: A protocol-version or engine-identity mismatch marks the exact arm unavailable; the CONNECT fault debits that arm once and is quarantine-eligible.
worker_handshake.request_behavior: Requests never select an unavailable arm and bypass with prefill_bypass_reason=quarantined. This reports the arm's health-scoped unavailable state without adding a protocol-mismatch token.
worker_handshake.mid_attempt_defense_in_depth: A mismatch that somehow surfaces after a split attempt has begun maps to dispatch_failure.

arm_schema.inheritance: none across decode_config, bucket, or machine_profile

artifact_triple.eligibility_rule: A loaded arm is eligible only when its source_checkpoint_digest matches the manifest and its derived_or_compiled_artifact_digest matches the certification_recorded_artifact_digest. An unloaded certified arm with a matching source checkpoint is selectable; readiness must verify the complete triple before its first use.
artifact_triple.postselection_load_completion_mismatch: artifact_mismatch fallback with one exact-arm health debit and no certification-row mutation

runtime_state_derivation.certified: a current green row exists for the exact arm
runtime_state_derivation.bucket_absent: a recorded certification attempt for the exact arm ended absent
runtime_state_derivation.not_certified: no attempt row exists for the exact arm

certification.absence_response_mapping: Every recorded absent row maps to the runtime bypass reason bucket_absent; its absence_reason is available only through the evidence record and operations query.

split_arm_correctness_gate.decision_provenance: Owner-ratified on 2026-08-14; parameters are derived from docs/diag-ane-prefill-divergence.md and docs/diag-ane-prefill-m1-authority.md.
split_arm_correctness_gate.scope: Only ANE-prefill split arms are judged by this gate. Pure-GPU decode exactness, embedding parity, and every other lane retain their existing gates.
split_arm_correctness_gate.battery: Each exact arm is judged independently over its 20 width-exact prompts against the same-decode-config pure-GPU oracle, with 64 greedy generated tokens per prompt.
split_arm_correctness_gate.first_fork_only: A prompt is judged at its first divergent generated-token position. After a legal fork, the remaining continuation may differ freely and is not another fork.
split_arm_correctness_gate.top2_swap: At every first fork, the split-selected token and oracle-selected token must form the same two-token top-2 set in both logits rows, with the order reversed between rows; each selected token is therefore the other row's top-2 candidate.

logit_near_tie.comparison: absolute top-1 minus top-2 gap in each logits row is strictly less than the limit

kv_admission_fidelity.reference: The raw Core ML f16 K/V is compared with owned-Metal f16 pure-GPU prefill before any q8-step engine-to-engine handoff; token-fork logits still use the exact arm's same-decode-config oracle.

split_arm_correctness_gate.evidence: Certification output records each fork position, both ordered top-2 token sets, both gaps, and the harness-computed swap verdict, plus per-prompt active-position K/V p95 and admission roundtrip bit mismatches.
split_arm_correctness_gate.failure: A non-swap fork, a gap outside the strict band, a fourth fork in one arm's 20-prompt battery, K/V p95 above the limit, a non-byte-faithful admission roundtrip, or incomplete evidence fails that exact arm with correctness_divergence.

auxiliary_corpora.rule: Exercise split execution, fixed-window active-position invariants, grammar handling, and chain composition. Continuation token equality is not a correctness requirement for the distinct ane-split processing identity.

certification_requirements.ttft: warm-package split p50 must be lower than same-config pure-GPU p50
certification_requirements.w128_headline: both W128 decode configs require pure-GPU p50 / split p50 >= 5.0

reason_vocabularies.disjointness_requirement: The three vocabularies are pairwise disjoint; a spelling belongs to exactly one namespace.

bypass_table.unavailable_arm_mapping: A CONNECT-time protocol-version or engine-identity mismatch has already charged this exact arm once and made it quarantine-eligible; later requests bypass without an additional debit.

selection_algorithm: enumerate included buckets greater than or equal to canonical prompt length in ascending order
remove buckets whose exact decode_config lacks cache_bucket >= prompt_length + max_tokens
select the first ascending exact arm with a green row, matching artifact triple, and no quarantine; unloaded matching arms remain selectable for bounded readiness
when no arm is selectable, derive bucket_absent, not_certified, artifact_digest_mismatch, or quarantined from the smallest remaining window alone
acquire the ANE guard within ane_attempt_budget_ms; failure is ane_busy and does not begin an attempt
after guard acquisition, evaluate remaining deadline feasibility; failure is deadline_too_tight and does not begin an attempt
routing.pinned_ane_split: Never substitute GPU. A pre-attempt class returns the existing identity-preserving failure without a debit; an in-attempt failure returns an identity-preserving execution failure and debits the exact arm once.
routing.unpinned: A bypass completes on GPU with prefill_engine=gpu and exactly one bypass reason. A fallback completes on GPU with prefill_engine=gpu, prefill_fallback_from=ane-w<bucket>, and exactly one fallback reason.

derived_values.readiness_budget_ms: configured loader compile-or-load budget; zero for artifact-warm requests

timing.guard_rule: ANE guard acquisition is pre-attempt and is bounded by ane_attempt_budget_ms. guard_wait_budget is retired and must not be independently configured.
timing.prediction_rule: The same calibrated ane_attempt_budget_ms bounds prediction after an attempt begins; guard time and prediction time are separately measured and never double-counted.
handoff_clock: stride-aware f16 K/V extraction and layout conversion
cache payload publication, transport, receipt, and validation
q8-step engine-to-engine cache conversion when applicable
timing.deadline_feasibility: elapsed_time + remaining readiness, prediction, handoff, and measured GPU-prefill p95 must fit the caller deadline

worst_case_fallback_rows.artifact_warm: consume guard, prediction, and handoff bounds; breach handoff last; then pay full GPU prefill
worst_case_fallback_rows.cold_ready: consume guard and readiness budget; fail readiness; then pay full GPU prefill

processing_fingerprint.canonical_encoding: serde_json::to_vec over the declared payload struct in the listed field order

certification_table.name: split_prefill_certification_rows
certification_table.write_rule: only certification/probe work writes certification outcomes; runtime fallback never mutates a green row

health_table.name: split_prefill_arm_health
health_table.failure_rule: each fallback or pinned in-attempt failure adds exactly one strike to this arm and zero strikes to the decode-lane worker key
health_table.success_rule: a successful split attempt resets only this arm's consecutive_strikes to zero
health_table.expiry_rule: quarantine expiry enters probation at max_strikes - 1; one failure re-quarantines and one success clears probation
health_table.restart_rule: both rows persist across process restart; load_state is process-local and is re-derived from the persisted certification row and artifact triple

migration.shape: create both split-prefill tables without rewriting existing worker-key crash-budget records
migration.split_arm_records: new records use the exact four-field arm key and consecutive semantics

recorded_owner_branches.escape: adding a decode-side capacity requires an owner decision in the operations document
in_process_bridge requires design-note proof of isolation, fallback, timeout, guard, lifecycle, and restart ownership
decode_only_charging requires an owner decision and admission-path tracing
owner decision may authorize enable after CALIBRATION-FAILED is recorded
